'''Ralnar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He commanded [[Camp Beskar]] during the [[Skirmish on Carlac]] and was defeated when [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|A Jedi Knight]] infiltrated the camp.

==Equipment==
Lieutenant Ralnar wore yellow and gray [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] and used his wrist mounted [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] as his choice of weapon during the [[Skirmish on Carlac]].
